note.value:
1. Initiative Phase Each side rolls a d6
    If a tie, wind changes direction; even 1 position clockwise; odd 1 position anticlockwise. Reroll initiative.
  2. Magic Phase: The player with initiative may cast a spell, then the other player may cast a spell.
  3. Battle Phase
    Starting with the initiative winner, take turns moving ships/squadrons.
    1. Move
    2. Combat
    3. Ramming and Boarding
  4. End Phase
    Pick up survivors; Remove debris; Fires spread; Move stragglers; Scuttle ships; Remove counters; Pick up Magic Cards; Decide victory
